description: Defines the OutputFormat enum with cases for txt and srt, and includes methods for generating text representations of transcripts based on format, including timestamp formatting for subtitles.

methods.name: needsAudioTimeRange
methods.description: Determines if the format requires audio time range information.

methods.name: text(for: maxLength:)
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the transcript based on the output format, with special handling for subtitle formats like SRT, including timestamp formatting.
